office: the Registrar under the Registration of Persons Act
note: The Marshall Islands has a national ID card, issued in physical form only; under the Registration of Persons Act 1989 only citizens may apply for it, and it does not confer citizenship (SEAP digital ID overview). The fee, the age, the term and the time weren't found.

sources.title: Institute on Statelessness and Inclusion / SEAP, Digital ID overview: Marshall Islands
sources.said: Marshall Islands also has a national ID card, but it is currently not digitised. ... According to the Marshall Islands’ Registrations of Persons Act of 1989, only citizens of Marshall Islands are eligible to apply for a national ID card, a document that verifies an individual’s identity.
